sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zoran Mamdani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、佐兰·马姆达尼等许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews at nytimes.com and in the Times app on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 和《纽约时报》App 上对部分采访进行直播。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不会想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, every day from before sunrise until late into the night, undocumented immigrants across the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今天，从日出之前到深夜，全美的无证移民都在被 ICE 官员带走，

sentences.en: are being picked up by ICE officers, the frontline soldiers in President Trump's crackdown on illegal immigration.
sentences.zh: 他们是特朗普总统打击非法移民行动中的一线士兵。

sentences.en: And increasingly, the arrests are collateral.
sentences.zh: 而且，这些逮捕行动越来越多地波及到了无辜的旁观者。

sentences.en: People officers come across while looking for somebody else.
sentences.zh: 也就是执法人员在搜寻其他人时偶然遇到的人。

sentences.en: It's Monday, July 31St.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月31日，星期一。

sentences.en: Um, I'm so sorry.
sentences.zh: 呃，非常抱歉。

sentences.en: What is your name?
sentences.zh: 你叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Anna?
sentences.zh: 安娜？

sentences.en: A-N-N-A?
sentences.zh: A-N-N-A?

sentences.en: A-N-A.
sentences.zh: A-N-A.

sentences.en: It's Anna Delgado.
sentences.zh: 我是安娜·德尔加多。

sentences.en: So what happened to David?
sentences.zh: 那大卫怎么了？

sentences.en: They came looking for my brother, and they, instead of taking him, they took my dad, who didn't find my brother.
sentences.zh: 他们是来找我哥哥的，但他们没有抓他，而是抓了我爸爸，当时我哥哥根本不在。

sentences.en: How does this, how does this situation, if your father is deported, how does that leave you guys?
sentences.zh: 这种情况，如果你的父亲被驱逐出境，会对你们家造成什么影响？

sentences.en: He's the one that held up the household.
sentences.zh: 他是这个家的顶梁柱。

sentences.en: There's really nothing here for us.
sentences.zh: 这里对我们来说真的什么都没有了。

sentences.en: Since he took office, about 65,000 undocumented immigrants have been arrested, which is about a 40% increase over the same time period last year.
sentences.zh: 自上任以来，大约有65,000名无证移民被捕，比去年同期增加了约40%。

sentences.en: That's a very meaningful increase.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常显著的增长。

sentences.en: Huge.
sentences.zh: 极其巨大。

sentences.en: My colleague Jennifer Medina recently spent a day in the field with immigration officers enforcing the president's new policies and documented their encounter with the Delgado family.
sentences.zh: 我的同事詹妮弗·梅迪纳最近跟随执行总统新政策的移民执法人员在实地工作了一天，并记录了他们与德尔加多一家的遭遇。

sentences.en: So we went to Riverside, California, which is about 50 miles east of Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 我们去了加利福尼亚州的里弗赛德，它位于洛杉矶以东大约50英里处。

sentences.en: And we were in a part of Riverside that is quite rural.
sentences.zh: 我们在里弗赛德一个相当乡村化的地区。

sentences.en: This is not the sort of urban area people think of when they think of Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 这可不是人们想到洛杉矶时脑海中浮现的那种市区。

sentences.en: It's a lot of farms, a lot of small ranches.
sentences.zh: 这里有很多农场，很多小型牧场。

sentences.en: People tend to have chickens and horses in their backyard.
sentences.zh: 人们的后院通常养着鸡和马。

sentences.en: And it has become a pretty heavily Mexican immigrant community, mostly because real estate there is much cheaper than it is in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 这里已经变成了一个墨西哥移民聚集的社区，主要是因为那里的房地产比洛杉矶便宜得多。

sentences.en: Are we all ready?
sentences.zh: 大家都准备好了吗？

sentences.en: Everybody ready?
sentences.zh: 所有人准备好了吗？

sentences.en: We'll go ahead and brief.
sentences.zh: 我们这就开始简报。

sentences.en: So we met immigration officers at 4.30 in the morning in the parking lot of a hardware store, which is where they started their operation.
sentences.zh: 我们在清晨4点30分于一家五金店的停车场与移民官员会合，这也是他们行动的起点。

sentences.en: Putting on their bulletproof vest, drinking their coffee.
sentences.zh: 他们穿上防弹衣，喝着咖啡。

sentences.en: All right, go ahead.
sentences.zh: 好的，开始吧。

sentences.en: Then if everybody's ready, get started.
sentences.zh: 如果大家都准备好了，那就开始。

sentences.en: And then they just sort of gather in a circle and go over who they're targeting for the day.
sentences.zh: 然后他们围成一个圈，讨论当天行动的目标是谁。

sentences.en: They had six targets for that day.
sentences.zh: 他们那天有六个目标。

sentences.en: Where's the first?
sentences.zh: 第一个在哪里？

sentences.en: How far is the first target from here?
sentences.zh: 第一个目标离这里有多远？

sentences.en: Not that far.
sentences.zh: 不是很远。

sentences.en: And the head of the operation went over the details of everybody they were looking for.
sentences.zh: 行动负责人详细交代了他们寻找的每一个人的情况。

sentences.en: So who they were, where they lived, what time they were going to leave their house.
sentences.zh: 比如他们是谁，住在哪里，打算什么时间离开家。

sentences.en: The surveillance yesterday suggested that he returns from a late shift.
sentences.zh: 昨天的监视表明他值完晚班回来了。

sentences.en: He arrives home at 8.40 in the morning.
sentences.zh: 他早上8点40分到家。

sentences.en: What crime they had committed, all those sorts of things in sort of a briefing before taking off to go throughout the city to do these arrests.
sentences.zh: 他们犯过什么罪，诸如此类的细节，在出发前往全市各处进行逮捕前作简要通报。

sentences.en: Darren, what time did you say he comes back?
sentences.zh: 达伦，你刚才说他几点回来？

sentences.en: And how do these officers find their targets?
sentences.zh: 这些官员是如何找到他们的目标的？

sentences.en: It's a little bit of a mystery.
sentences.zh: 这有点神秘。

sentences.en: They were pretty hesitant to give us really real details on that.
sentences.zh: 他们对向我们透露真正细节显得十分犹豫。

sentences.en: It used to be that many jails would hold undocumented immigrants longer than their sentence so that immigration officers could come pick them up.
sentences.zh: 过去，许多监狱会把无证移民在服刑期满后继续扣留一段时间，以便移民官员来接走他们。

sentences.en: That's now outlawed in California for the most part.
sentences.zh: 加州现在基本上已经取缔了这种做法。

sentences.en: And so they say, you know, they rely on jail records.
sentences.zh: 所以他们说，你知道的，他们依靠监狱记录。

sentences.en: They rely on tips to find anybody who has committed a crime and is here illegally.
sentences.zh: 他们依靠线索来寻找任何犯过罪且非法滞留这里的人。

sentences.en: And when he arrives home from work, as soon as he parks, we're going to come up and effect the arrest right there, be it either on the street.
sentences.zh: 当他下班回家时，他一停车，我们就会上前当场实施逮捕，不管是在街上还是哪里。

sentences.en: And why do they start in the morning, and in this case, so early in the morning?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们要在清晨行动，而且这次这么早？

sentences.en: The reason they do it in the morning is because they say it's safer to do it in daylight hours.
sentences.zh: 他们选择在早上行动的原因是，他们说在白天行动更安全。

sentences.en: People tend to be calm.
sentences.zh: 人们往往比较冷静。

sentences.en: There tends to be less crowds.
sentences.zh: 人群通常较少。

sentences.en: So one of the things that has happened in California and elsewhere is that when there have been deportation arrests in the middle of the day,
sentences.zh: 所以在加州和其他地方发生的情况之一是，当白天进行驱逐逮捕时，

sentences.en: many crowds are around and people are filming it on their cell phone.
sentences.zh: 周围往往聚集了很多人，人们正用手机拍摄。

sentences.en: And they're trying to avoid that.
sentences.zh: 而他们正试图避免这种情况。

sentences.en: So they're trying to look for the most low-key way of doing these arrests.
sentences.zh: 所以他们试图寻找最低调的方式来执行这些逮捕。

sentences.en: Remember officer safety, you know.
sentences.zh: 记住要注意警员安全，你知道的。

sentences.en: Hey, you know what, we're all going to go home today.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我们要确保今天所有人都能平安回家。

sentences.en: If that guy gets away, you guys will get him some other time.
sentences.zh: 如果那家伙跑了，你们以后总能抓到他。

sentences.en: All right, so just remember that.
sentences.zh: 好的，记住这一点。

sentences.en: Good to go.
sentences.zh: 没问题了。

sentences.en: We're going to load up.
sentences.zh: 我们要上车了。

sentences.en: Oh, you're fired.
sentences.zh: 哦，你被解雇了。

sentences.en: So my name is David Marin.
sentences.zh: 我叫大卫·马林。

sentences.en: I am the field office director here in Los Angeles for enforcement and removal operations.
sentences.zh: 我是执法与遣返行动局洛杉矶现场办公室的主任。

sentences.en: What we prioritize is to go after the worst of the worSt.
sentences.zh: 我们的首要任务是抓捕最恶劣的罪犯。

sentences.en: So there's estimated about 2 million illegal aliens just in these seven counties alone.
sentences.zh: 仅在这七个县内，就有大约200万非法外国人。

sentences.en: We can't arrest everybody.
sentences.zh: 我们不可能把所有人都抓起来。

sentences.en: So the greatest impact that we're going to be able to make on public safety is by going after the most serious criminals first, right?
sentences.zh: 因此，我们能对公共安全产生的最大影响，就是首先去抓捕那些最严重的罪犯，对吧？

sentences.en: We're going to go back to the location.
sentences.zh: 我们要返回那个地点。

sentences.en: Target.
sentences.zh: 目标。

sentences.en: Guerrero, copy.
sentences.zh: 格雷罗，收到。

sentences.en: You're going 91 weSt.
sentences.zh: 你们正向91号公路西行。

sentences.en: Careful, we're moving.
sentences.zh: 小心，我们出发了。

sentences.en: Do you got, okay.
sentences.zh: 你拿到了吗，好的。

sentences.en: I just copied that, that we're moving.
sentences.zh: 我刚收到消息，我们正在行动。

sentences.en: Are we going to hit it?
sentences.zh: 我们要去突击吗？

sentences.en: The first person they went after wasn't home when they got there and they expected him to be home.
sentences.zh: 他们去抓的第一个人到家时不在家，而他们原本预计他在家的。

sentences.en: So most of the officers left that home and went to the second target.
sentences.zh: 于是大部分警员离开那个住所，前往第二个目标。

sentences.en: Which was, what's my list here?
sentences.zh: 也就是，我的名单上是什么？

sentences.en: Delgado Rocha.
sentences.zh: 德尔加多·罗查。

sentences.en: Mariano Delgado Rocha.
sentences.zh: 马里亚诺·德尔加多·罗查。
zh_words: 马里亚诺·德尔加多·罗查

sentences.en: Who is a 24-year-old Mexican national who was convicted of drunk driving in 2011 and then returned to Mexico and came back to the United States illegally.
sentences.zh: 他是一名24岁的墨西哥国民，2011年曾因酒后驾车被定罪，随后返回墨西哥，之后又非法偷渡回美国。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Since then, he'd been arrested about four times for assault with a deadly weapon.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，他大约因持致命武器袭击罪被捕了四次。

sentences.en: I copy this.
sentences.zh: 我收到了。

sentences.en: I'm pulling her in front.
sentences.zh: 我把车开到前面。

sentences.en: So a clear figure to be arrested and presumably deported by ICE agents.
sentences.zh: 因此，这是一个应该被 ICE 特工逮捕并推测会被驱逐出境的明确目标。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Somebody they would consider a priority.
sentences.zh: 他们认为的优先逮捕对象。

sentences.en: Okay, so we're going to move forward.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们要前进了。

sentences.en: We're going to hit the house.
sentences.zh: 我们要对这所房子进行突击。

sentences.en: There's a chain-link fence all around this home.
sentences.zh: 这所房子周围全都是链式围栏。

sentences.en: So the officer first just needs to shout to try to get somebody to come out of the house.
sentences.zh: 因此，警员首先需要大喊，试图让屋里的人出来。

sentences.en: And a woman, which ended up being Mariano's mother, came out pretty quickly and asked first if the officer spoke Spanish.
sentences.zh: 一个后来证实是马里亚诺母亲的女人很快走了出来，先问警员会不会说西班牙语。

sentences.en: He answered that he did and told her to come out and bring her ID.
sentences.zh: 他回答说会，并叫她出来带上身份证。

sentences.en: And she did that instantly.
sentences.zh: 她立刻照做了。

sentences.en: Remember, it's six in the morning.
sentences.zh: 记住，当时才早上六点。

sentences.en: She's in her pajamas.
sentences.zh: 她还穿着睡衣。

sentences.en: And she's just confused.
sentences.zh: 她感到非常困惑。

sentences.en: Like, who are these people showing up with guns at my house?
sentences.zh: 心想：这些带着枪出现在我家里的人到底是谁？

sentences.en: Are guns drawn or just holstered?
sentences.zh: 他们是拔出枪还是把枪收在枪套里？

sentences.en: Most of them are holstered.
sentences.zh: 大部分都收在枪套里。

sentences.en: But one of the officers has a rifle slung across his cheSt.
sentences.zh: 但其中一名警员胸前斜挎着一支步枪。

sentences.en: So it's hard to miss that.
sentences.zh: 所以这很难不引起注意。

sentences.en: So after the woman gives them permission to come through the gate and enter the house, the officer with the rifle sort of stands to the side, basically watching guard.
sentences.zh: 在这名女性允许他们穿过大门进入房屋后，带有步枪的警员便站在一旁，基本上负责警戒。

sentences.en: And about four officers enter the home.
sentences.zh: 大约有四名警员进入了屋里。

sentences.en: And they're looking for Mariano and they're asking where he is.
sentences.zh: 他们在寻找马里亚诺并询问他在哪里。

sentences.en: Del Delgado is the father.
sentences.zh: 德尔加多是父亲。

sentences.en: At this point, the father has come out and he's shirtless.
sentences.zh: 此时，父亲走了出来，赤裸着上身。

sentences.en: And again, sort of very obvious that he has just woken up and is quite confused about what's going on.
sentences.zh: 同样，很明显他刚醒来，对发生了什么感到十分困惑。

sentences.en: And he tells the officers, look, Mariano doesn't live here.
sentences.zh: 他告诉警员，听着，马里亚诺不住这里。

sentences.en: He moved to Texas a while ago.
sentences.zh: 他不久前搬去德克萨斯州了。

sentences.en: We haven't heard from him in a while.
sentences.zh: 我们已经很久没他的消息了。

sentences.en: We don't know anything about him.
sentences.zh: 我们对他一无所知。

sentences.en: The officers asked if they were in the country illegally.
sentences.zh: 警员询问他们是否非法滞留在国内。

sentences.en: And they immediately answered yes.
sentences.zh: 他们立刻回答说是。

sentences.en: So they're both prior people?
sentences.zh: 所以他们俩都是前科人员？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But they sort of pleaded, like, without being asked any other questions, with the officers sort of saying that they were good people who work good jobs.
sentences.zh: 但他们近乎哀求般地向警员解释，甚至没等对方问其他问题，就主动说他们是好人，有一份好工作。

sentences.en: They hadn't done anything wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们没有做错任何事。

sentences.en: They hadn't committed any crimes is how they would put it.
sentences.zh: 用他们的话说，他们没有犯过任何罪。

sentences.en: The officers mostly don't discuss anything in front of the family.
sentences.zh: 警员们大多不在家人面前讨论事情。

sentences.en: It's not until they walk outside, a group of about four of them, where they try to figure out, OK, what are we going to do now?
sentences.zh: 直到他们走出屋外，大约四个人聚在一起，才开始琢磨：好吧，我们现在该怎么办？

sentences.en: And why are they having what seems like a bit of a dilemma about what to do?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们对下一步怎么做显得有些左右为难？

sentences.en: Because the son is not there?
sentences.zh: 因为儿子不在那儿？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: The person who they're looking for isn't there, but they've found two illegal immigrants.
sentences.zh: 他们要找的人不在，但他们却找到了两个非法移民。

sentences.en: Both this wife and her husband had crossed the border and been caught twice.
sentences.zh: 这名妻子和她的丈夫都曾越过边境并被抓获过两次。

sentences.en: They were in the system already as having tried to enter illegally.
sentences.zh: 他们的系统里已经有非法入境未遂的记录了。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Would that make both of them criminals?
sentences.zh: 这会使他们两人都成为罪犯吗？

sentences.en: In the eyes of the Trump administration, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普政府眼里，绝对算。

sentences.en: And there's one minor here?
sentences.zh: 这里还有一个未成年人吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Do you know who?
sentences.zh: 你知道是谁吗？

sentences.en: No, it appears to be maybe 15.
sentences.zh: 不知道，看起来大概15岁左右。

sentences.en: What are they going to do about this husband and wife, Mariano's parents?
sentences.zh: 他们打算怎么处理这对夫妻，也就是马里亚诺的父母？

sentences.en: So that's what they kind of come out of the house to discuss.
sentences.zh: 所以这正是他们走出屋子要商量的事情。

sentences.en: Interestingly, only one of the officers of about a dozen or so who we were with was a woman.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，在我们同行的大约十二名警员中，只有一名是女警。

sentences.en: And the woman was really the one in charge right at this point of deciding what to do.
sentences.zh: 而这位女警才是此时决定该怎么做的真正负责人。

sentences.en: And she sort of talks it over with her supervisor and says, look, you know, we could take them both.
sentences.zh: 她和她的主管商量了一下，然后说，你看，我们其实可以把他们两个都带走。

sentences.en: And another one of the officers chimed in, if the father doesn't give up the son, we're going to take him.
sentences.zh: 另一名警员插话道，如果父亲不交出儿子，我们就把他带走。

sentences.en: And they ultimately decide that if they take both, that means they need to call Child Protective Services for the teenage son, which they don't want to do.
sentences.zh: 他们最终决定，如果把两人都带走，就意味着需要为十几岁的儿子联系儿童保护局，而这是他们不想做的。

sentences.en: Oh, because they will have literally taken two parents away from their underage son.
sentences.zh: 哦，因为他们等于是把未成年儿子的父母双亲都带走了。

sentences.en: From their underage U.S.-born citizen son.
sentences.zh: 带走了他们身为美国公民的未成年儿子。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Which they don't seem willing to do.
sentences.zh: 而这似乎是他们不愿意做的。

sentences.en: We could make the decision, right, to arrest one person, leave one here to watch the child,
sentences.zh: 我们可以做决定，逮捕一个人，留一个人在这里看着孩子，

sentences.en: but then serve that individual with a letter to have them report into our office so they can take their child with them.
sentences.zh: 然后向这个人送达一张传唤信，让他们去我们的办公室报到，这样他们就能把孩子一起带上。

sentences.en: Because, I mean, so that's something that our officers wrestle with every day also.
sentences.zh: 因为，我是说，这也是我们的警员每天都在纠结的问题。

sentences.en: So do we arrest both the family members and then call Child Protective Services?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们是把家庭成员两人都逮捕，然后联系儿童保护局吗？

sentences.en: So they decide, okay, we're going to take the father and leave the mother.
sentences.zh: 于是他们决定，好吧，我们要带走父亲，留下母亲。

sentences.en: She's not a threat to society.
sentences.zh: 她对社会没有威胁。

sentences.en: We'll take in her husband, leave her to take her son, and we'll figure out what to do with her later.
sentences.zh: 我们带走她的丈夫，留下她照顾儿子，至于她以后该怎么办，我们到时候再想办法。

sentences.en: And do they explain why they chose the father over the mother?
sentences.zh: 他们有没有解释为什么选择父亲而不是母亲？

sentences.en: It just seems like an extraordinary kind of roll of the dice of who got chosen that day.
sentences.zh: 这看起来就像那天到底谁被选中有极大的随机性。

sentences.en: I think it is, and I think it's a little bit the sort of general sense that mothers tend to be the caregivers.
sentences.zh: 我想确实如此，而且我觉得这也部分源于一种普遍观念，即母亲往往是照顾孩子的人。

sentences.en: Whether that's outdated or not, it probably is true in this family.
sentences.zh: 不管这种观念是否过时，在这个家庭里可能确实如此。

sentences.en: Fidel, the father, was the one who brought home a bigger paycheck, and that was something the family ended up being very worried about.
sentences.zh: 父亲菲德尔赚的钱更多，这也是这家人最终非常担心的事情。

sentences.en: But it is absolutely sort of a roll of the dice and a very subjective decision over who to take in.
sentences.zh: 但带走谁绝对带有很大的偶然性，是一个非常主观的决定。

sentences.en: Let's roll, then.
sentences.zh: 那我们走吧。

sentences.en: So the father is arrested, and it's actually very quiet, the whole process.
sentences.zh: 于是父亲被捕了，整个过程其实非常安静。

sentences.en: I mean, he came out.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他走了出来。

sentences.en: There was no resistance, no shouting or anything.
sentences.zh: 没有反抗，没有大喊大叫，什么都没有。

sentences.en: He just sort of looks down and walks to this unmarked van.
sentences.zh: 他只是有点低着头，走向那辆无标志的厢式货车。

sentences.en: Great work, guys.
sentences.zh: 干得好，伙计们。

sentences.en: Great job.
sentences.zh: 干得漂亮。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And about a mile away, they take him out of the van, have him put all of his belongings in a plain brown paper bag,
sentences.zh: 大约一英里外，他们把他从车里带出来，让他把所有随身物品放进一个普通的牛皮纸袋里，

sentences.en: and then chain him with a belly chain, chain his handcuffs to his waiSt.
sentences.zh: 然后给他套上腰链，把他的手铐锁在腰部。

sentences.en: So where is he headed to, what's his fate for the day?
sentences.zh: 那他要去哪里？他今天的命运会怎样？

sentences.en: So he'll go back to the San Bernardino office, and he'll be processed for removal.
sentences.zh: 他将返回圣贝纳迪诺办公室，并被走程序进行驱逐。

sentences.en: If he doesn't claim credible fear, if he doesn't contest anything, he'll be removed back to Mexico today.
sentences.zh: 如果他不声称自己有可信的恐惧，如果不提出异议，他今天就会被驱逐回墨西哥。

sentences.en: So when they get to the process center, the van pulls in, and Fidel is there with four other immigrants.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达处理中心时，货车驶入，菲德尔和另外四名移民在那里。

sentences.en: And then they're given a brown bag lunch of a turkey sandwich and an apple and some apple juice, and they sit in sort of a holding pen.
sentences.zh: 然后他们拿到了一份装在纸袋里的午餐，包括一个火鸡三明治、一个苹果和一些苹果汁，他们坐在一个类似拘留栏的地方。

sentences.en: And what did he look like to you, sitting there?
sentences.zh: 在他坐在那里的时候，你觉得他看起来怎么样？

sentences.en: He looked sort of forlorn and confused and exhausted.
sentences.zh: 他看起来有点绝望、困惑和疲惫。

sentences.en: So it sounds like before this happened, which I guess means before President Trump was elected, he felt that his security as someone living in the United States was not in danger.
sentences.zh: 听起来在这件事发生之前，也就是特朗普总统当选之前，他觉得生活在美国的安全并没有受到威胁。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And even since the Trump administration, he did not know anybody who had been arrested.
sentences.zh: 甚至在特朗普政府上台之后，他也不认识任何被捕的人。

sentences.en: He said, of course, he'd seen things on the news, but it hadn't happened to anybody he knew.
sentences.zh: 他说，他当然在新闻上看到过一些事，但这并没有发生在他认识的人身上。

sentences.en: So it wasn't something he was sort of living in fear about.
sentences.zh: 所以这不是那种让他生活在恐惧之中的事。

sentences.en: So, Jenny, is what the ICE officers did here legal, as best you can tell?
sentences.zh: 那么，珍妮，就你所能了解的来看，移民及海关执法局警员在这里的做法是合法的吗？

sentences.en: I mean, they went into the house looking for this one target, the son, Mariano, who had a long criminal record.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们进入房子是为了找这个特定的目标，也就是有很长犯罪记录的儿子马里亚诺。

sentences.en: And they found someone completely different, who doesn't have what we would probably regard as a traditional criminal past, other than crossing the border.
sentences.zh: 结果他们却找到了一个完全不同的人，除了越境外，他并没有我们通常认为的那种传统犯罪前科。

sentences.en: Is that all proper and by the books?
sentences.zh: 这一切都合规且按章办事吗？

sentences.en: It's certainly proper and by the books under the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普政府领导下，这绝对是合规且按章办事的。

sentences.en: What President Trump did is really expand the term criminal.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统所做的事，实际上是扩大了罪犯的定义。

sentences.en: And anybody who has crossed the border illegally is considered a criminal.
sentences.zh: 任何非法越境的人都被视为罪犯。

sentences.en: And that's enabled officers to arrest many, many more people.
sentences.zh: 这使得警员能够逮捕更多、更多的人。

sentences.en: Under the last couple of years of President Obama, anybody who had not committed a serious crime,
sentences.zh: 在奥巴马总统任期的最后几年，任何没有犯下严重罪行的人，

sentences.en: so something like a murder, a rape, armed robbery, was not considered a priority for deportation.
sentences.zh: 比如谋杀、强奸、持械抢劫之类的事情，都不会被视为驱逐出境的优先对象。

sentences.en: And if an immigration officer came across that kind of undocumented immigrant, they would leave them alone, essentially.
sentences.zh: 如果移民警员遇到这种无证移民，他们基本上就会置之不理。

sentences.en: Now that's not the case.
sentences.zh: 现在情况可不是这样了。

sentences.en: If an immigration officer comes across anybody who's here illegally, they're almost always arrested at this point.
sentences.zh: 如果移民警员遇到任何非法滞留的人，目前几乎总是会将其逮捕。

sentences.en: So you're saying because the idea of what is criminal has been expanded, that anybody who is here illegally has committed a crime,
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，因为犯罪的概念被扩大了，任何非法在这里的人都犯了罪，

sentences.en: and if immigration officers find them, that crime is enough to be arrested.
sentences.zh: 如果移民警员发现了他们，这个罪名就足以成为被捕的理由。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So how often do they end up arresting and even deporting these kind of incidental collateral figures like Fidel?
sentences.zh: 那么他们最终逮捕甚至驱逐像菲德尔这样并非主要目标的附带人员的情况有多频繁？

sentences.en: It's hard to know right now how much that has gone up in the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 目前很难知道在特朗普政府期间这种情况增加了多少。

sentences.en: They haven't yet really released the distinguishing the number of people with criminal records versus people without.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上还没有公布有犯罪记录人数与无犯罪记录人数的具体区分数据。

sentences.en: But it's safe to assume that across the country, it's happening daily.
sentences.zh: 但可以肯定的是，全国上下每天都在发生这种情况。

sentences.en: My what?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: I bursted in tears.
sentences.zh: 我当时放声大哭。

sentences.en: My dad means a lot to me.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸对我很重要。

sentences.en: He's my world.
sentences.zh: 他是我的全世界。

sentences.en: He's everything to me.
sentences.zh: 他是我的一切。

sentences.en: And yeah, it hurt.
sentences.zh: 真的，这很伤人。

sentences.en: It hurt because he's an innocent man.
sentences.zh: 这很伤人，因为他是一个无辜的人。

sentences.en: He's a hardworking guy.
sentences.zh: 他是一个努力工作的人。

sentences.en: He never stops working no matter what.
sentences.zh: 无论发生什么，他从不停下工作。

sentences.en: No matter what.
sentences.zh: 无论发生什么。

sentences.en: He gets up every day, every day.
sentences.zh: 他每天都起床，每一天。

sentences.en: And for an innocent person, like to just get taken like that?
sentences.zh: 而一个无辜的人，就这样被抓走了？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: He didn't deserve that.
sentences.zh: 他不该遭受这样的对待。

sentences.en: He didn't, you know?
sentences.zh: 他不该，你知道吗？

sentences.en: We're officers.
sentences.zh: 我们是警员。

sentences.en: We have children too, and we're human beings.
sentences.zh: 我们也有孩子，我们也是人。

sentences.en: And we know the impact that that has on a child when uniformed officers come in and take a parent away.
sentences.zh: 我们知道当身穿制服的警员进来带走父母时，会对孩子造成什么影响。

sentences.en: We know that that's going to impact that child for the rest of their life, you know?
sentences.zh: 我们知道这会在余下的人生中一直影响那个孩子，你知道吗？

sentences.en: But that's not our fault.
sentences.zh: 但这不是我们的错。

sentences.en: That individual that convicted that crime that's here illegally, that's the person that broke up the family.
sentences.zh: 那个犯下罪行、非法滞留这里的人，那才是拆散这个家庭的人。

sentences.en: That's not our fault, you know?
sentences.zh: 这不是我们的错，你知道吗？

sentences.en: So this is somebody that was previously deported, you know?
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个以前被驱逐出境过的人，你知道吗？

sentences.en: So someone that has had an opportunity, you know, that was here and, well, attempted to enter and was caught and deported.
sentences.zh: 也就是有机会留在这里，但——曾试图入境却被抓住并驱逐出境的人。

sentences.en: And they're back in the country illegally.
sentences.zh: 而他们又非法回到了国内。

sentences.en: So absolutely somebody that shouldn't be here, right?
sentences.zh: 所以绝对是不应该呆在这里的人，对吧？

sentences.en: And there's consequences to that.
sentences.zh: 这是有后果的。

sentences.en: So is Fidel Delgado deported and back in Mexico now?
sentences.zh: 那么菲德尔·德尔加多现在被驱逐出境并回到墨西哥了吗？

sentences.en: He is not.
sentences.zh: 并没有。

sentences.en: We went to the home to talk with the family one more time the next day and learned that he had returned the very afternoon that he had been arrested and was back at work milking cows Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 第二天我们再次去他家与家人交谈，得知他在被捕的当天下午就回来了，并且在周五早上又回去挤牛奶了。

sentences.en: Why did that happen?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Why was he let go?
sentences.zh: 为什么他被释放了？

sentences.en: So immigration officers say that he was let go because he's not a threat.
sentences.zh: 移民警员说他被释放是因为他构不成威胁。

sentences.en: He's not deemed a flight risk and he's not deemed a public threat.
sentences.zh: 他被认为没有潜逃风险，也不被认为是公众威胁。

sentences.en: It's hard to know if that's exactly the reason.
sentences.zh: 很难知道这是否真的是原因。

sentences.en: It's also possible that they're sort of using him as a bargaining chip to get to the son.
sentences.zh: 也有可能是他们把他当作找到儿子的筹码。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, the person that they're really after is this guy, a 24-year-old guy with a criminal record.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们真正寻找的目标其实是这个人，一个有犯罪记录的24岁小伙子。

sentences.en: Perhaps they're thinking if we let the father go, the father will help us find his son.
sentences.zh: 也许他们在想，如果我们把父亲放了，父亲会帮我们找到他的儿子。

sentences.en: I'm struck by a couple of things about the scene you've been describing.
sentences.zh: 你刚才描述的那个场景让我注意到了一些事情。

sentences.en: Officer Marin really seemed to see these deportations and arrests as a pretty black and white issue of the law and right and wrong.
sentences.zh: 玛林警员似乎真的把这些驱逐和逮捕视为纯粹的黑白分明的法律问题以及是非对错问题。

sentences.en: But in the implementation of this policy, there seems to be a ton of discretion.
sentences.zh: 但在执行这项政策时，似乎存在着巨大的自由裁量权。

sentences.en: So how do you square that, especially knowing that Fidel Delgado was in the end released?
sentences.zh: 那么你如何看待这一点，尤其是考虑到菲德尔·德尔加多最终被释放了？

sentences.en: There is a ton of discretion for individual officers in a way there really hasn't been in years.
sentences.zh: 对于个别警员来说，存在着巨大的自由裁量权，这种程度是多年来所没有的。

sentences.en: Under the Obama administration, there really was quite a lot of regulations that officers routinely complained about.
sentences.zh: 在奥巴马政府统治时期，确实有相当多的规章制度是警员们经常抱怨的。

sentences.en: And Officer Marin complained about that very day.
sentences.zh: 玛林警员那天也抱怨过这一点。

sentences.en: Now officers have a lot more discretion over who they pick up and what they do with them.
sentences.zh: 现在，警员对抓捕谁以及如何处置这些人拥有更大的自由裁量权。

sentences.en: And I think for most of these officers, they see it as a chance of finally being able to do their job.
sentences.zh: 我想对于大多数警员来说，他们认为这是一个终于能够做好工作的机会。

sentences.en: They feel like they signed up to arrest people who were here illegally, and now that's what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得当初入职就是为了逮捕非法滞留的人，而现在他们正在做这件事。

sentences.en: So they feel unshackled.
sentences.zh: 所以他们感觉卸下了枷锁。

sentences.en: They feel unshackled.
sentences.zh: 他们感觉卸下了枷锁。

sentences.en: And it's also possible that these officers are perhaps softer than officers in other parts of the country,
sentences.zh: 也有可能这些警员比美国其他地区的警员更心软，

sentences.en: where the political attitudes are quite different and much more hostile to immigrants.
sentences.zh: 在那些地方，政治态度完全不同，对移民要敌视得多。

sentences.en: Probably none of them would call it capricious, but it's certainly in the eyes of the beholder, if what they're doing is effective or the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 可能他们中没有人会称之为反复无常，但他们所做的事情是否有效或是否正确，绝对是仁者见仁，智者见智。

sentences.en: And I guess with a whole lot of luck, or in some cases, bad luck involved.
sentences.zh: 我想这其中包含着极大的运气，或者在某些情况下，是不幸。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全是这样。

sentences.en: A lot of this has to do with luck from an immigrant's perspective.
sentences.zh: 从移民的角度来看，这很大程度上取决于运气。

sentences.en: I prayed a lot of God.
sentences.zh: 我向上帝祈祷了很多次。

sentences.en: So I told him, God, you know you can't allow this.
sentences.zh: 所以我对他说，上帝，你知道你不能允许这种事发生。

sentences.en: And I was happy.
sentences.zh: 我当时很高兴。

sentences.en: I heard the gate, I ran, and I hugged them.
sentences.zh: 我听到大门响了，我跑过去，拥抱了他们。

sentences.en: I hugged them, and I'm like, Daddy, you're out.
sentences.zh: 我抱住他们，我说：爸爸，你出来了。

sentences.en: I was happy.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴。

sentences.en: And it was God, honestly.
sentences.zh: 老实说，是上帝的保佑。

sentences.en: It was all God.
sentences.zh: 全都是上帝的安排。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Dana.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫达娜。

sentences.en: I am a subscriber to the New York Times, but my husband isn't.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的订户，但我丈夫不是。

sentences.en: And it would be really nice to be able to share a recipe or an article or compete with him in Wordle or Connections.
sentences.zh: 如果能跟他分享食谱或文章，或者跟他一起玩 Wordle 或 Connections 游戏，那就太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Dana, we heard you.
sentences.zh: 达娜，我们听到了您的心声。

sentences.en: It's why we created the New York Times Family Subscription.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们推出《纽约时报》家庭订阅服务的原因。

sentences.en: One subscription, up to four separate logins for anyone in your life.
sentences.zh: 只需一份订阅，即可为您生活中的任何人提供最多四个独立的登录账号。

sentences.en: Find out more at nytimes.com slash family.
sentences.zh: 请访问 nytimes.com/family 了解更多信息。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin says the United States must cut 755 members of its diplomatic staff in Russia by September 1St.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京表示，美国必须在9月1日之前将驻俄外交人员数量削减755人。

sentences.en: The announcement is a response to new sanctions passed by Congress last week and reluctantly signed onto by the White House on Friday,
sentences.zh: 这一宣布是对国会上周通过的新制裁措施的回应，白宫在周五迫于压力勉强签署了该法案，

sentences.en: under mounting pressure to toughen policies towards Russia after their meddling in the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 此前由于俄罗斯干预2016年大选，白宫面临着采取更强硬对俄政策的越来越大的压力。

sentences.en: And, President Trump is threatening to cancel health benefits for members of Congress if they don't revive a plan to repeal the Affordable Care Act.
sentences.zh: 此外，特朗普总统威胁称，如果国会议员不恢复废除《平价医疗法案》的计划，他将取消国会议员的医疗福利。

sentences.en: In a series of tweets over the weekend, President Trump said he would cut off a federal subsidy that funds the health insurance plans of congressmen and senators,
sentences.zh: 在周末的一系列推文中，特朗普总统表示，他将切断一项资助参议员和众议员健康保险计划的联邦补贴，

sentences.en: unless they pass the kind of health care bill that was voted down three times last week.
sentences.zh: 除非他们通过上周被三次投票否决的那种医疗法案。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。
